record.question: What is the recommended IV fluid for a patient with severe dehydration?
record.explanation: Answer A: Normal saline (0.9% NaCl). For severe dehydration requiring IV resuscitation, isotonic crystalloid is a first-line option; 0.9% saline is the only isotonic crystalloid offered. Fluid choice and rate depend on the cause, hemodynamics, electrolytes, cardiac/renal status, and reassessment. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK555956/; https://www.idsociety.org/globalassets/idsa/practice-guidelines/2017-infectious-diseases-society-of-america-clinical-practice-guidelines-for-the-diagnosis-and-management-of-infectious-diarrhea.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
